title: RECRAFT
description: Changing some crafting recipes and other QOL things
body:
Welcome to RECRAFT! This datapack is a crafting datapack that was originally made for a private server I was on. It changes the following crafting recipies:
- Arrows
- Anvils
- TNT
- tnt minecarts
- and dispensers.

the actual recipes are in the "gallery"

This datapack was inspired by hoplite and the Life Series to make PVP recipes a little easier.
